name: Museum Adventure: The Ascension of Huks
source:
Alan had always thought history was boring, until one eventful trip to the museum... A floating gold mask spirit flew up and asked him to help him move on to the afterlife! To help him, Alan must search through the museum's dioramas to find the mask spirit's previous belongings. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28476]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
艾伦一直认为历史很无聊，直到一次博物馆之旅……一个漂浮的金面具精灵飞来，请求他帮助他走向来世！为了帮助他，艾伦必须在博物馆的立体模型中寻找面具精神以前的物品。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=28476]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
